name: SO4AG Rental
description: Ten parameters with the highest impact for car and van rental. Every scope key restricts where a claim applies; the value any means all values of that key.

scope_keys.vehicle_class: Vehicle class code: mini, economy, compact, intermediate, standard, fullsize, premium, suv, van, minibus, other, any
scope_keys.vehicle: Specific vehicle model as named by the publisher (e.g. Škoda Kamiq DSG). Narrows a claim to that vehicle
scope_keys.rental_days: Number of rental days the price applies to (integer as string)
scope_keys.period_from: Start of the rental period the claim applies to (ISO 8601 date-time)
scope_keys.period_until: End of the rental period the claim applies to (ISO 8601 date-time)

operator.description: Legal entity operating the rental. Identifiers SHOULD include a registry number (cz-ico, sk-ico, lei).

branch.description: Pickup location with address and optional opening hours. The claim subject is the branch URI.

totalPrice.description: Total price for the whole rental of rental_days days including all mandatory fees and VAT.

refundableDeposit.description: Amount blocked or paid as a refundable security deposit. Never a rental price.

mileageLimit.description: Included distance per day (km/d) or per rental (km), or the code unlimited.

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: Methods accepted for the given purpose. Deposit and payment are separate claims.

minimumDriverAge.description: Minimum driver age in years (unit a).

additionalDriverFee.description: Fee for one additional driver per rental. 0.00 means free. If additional drivers are not allowed, knowledge_state is not_applicable.

freeCancellation.description: Hours before pickup until which cancellation is free (unit h), or a short text when the rule cannot be expressed as hours.

availability.description: Whether a vehicle of the class is available for the period. Live data: validity at most one hour. Without a live connection the claim MUST be unknown.
